accessibility.text: Consequentialism
An action is right if, of all available options, it would lead to the best outcome, and wrong otherwise.

The very simple argument for consequentialism
1. If one has the choice to bring about a worse outcome or a better outcome, one should never choose to bring about the worse outcome.
2. One should always choose to bring about the best outcome. (1)
C. Consequentialism is true. (2)
